Read the complete witness-statement passage. I was furious is wording being examined and tied to separate incidents during document revision. The frozen wording-as-object exclusion applies. b2 corrects the false positive.

Read the complete hearing passage. Agitated and angry is challenged as copied report wording; the passage examines the statement's evidential basis. The frozen wording-as-object exclusion applies. b2 corrects the false positive.
